svg.title: Irradiate with the cobalt-60 gamma source
svg.desc: Irradiate the solution using a 60Co gamma source with activity 2.59×10^15 Bq, to a reported dose of 3.0×10^4 Gy. Source activity is not a dose rate. Exposure time, geometry, vessel, atmosphere and dose rate are unreported. Source-bound concept; no physical apparatus geometry is established.

g.text: Irradiate with the cobalt-60 gamma source
Source-bound concept; no vessel, dimensions or fill levels inferred.
